subject: maths
question: A boat can go 10 km upstream and 11 km downstream in a total time of 52 minutes, If the speed of the stream is 5 km/h, then what is the speed (in km/h) of the boat when going downstream?
solution:
**Given:**

Total time taken by boat = 52 minutes

Distance travelled upstream = 10 km

Distance traveled downstream = 11 km

Speed of the stream = 5 km/h

**Concept used:**

Time = Distance/speed

Upstream speed = u - v

Downstream speed = u + v

(a² - b²) = (a + b)(a - b)

Here, u = speed of the object

v = speed of the stream

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the boat be x km/h

According to the question,

(10)/(x-5)+(11)/(x+5)=(52)/(60)

⇒ (10)/(x-5)+(11)/(x+5)=(13)/(15)

⇒ (10x+50+11x-55)/((x-5)(x+5))=(13)/(15)

⇒ (21x-5)/((x²-25))=(13)/(15)

⇒ 315x - 75 = 13x² - 325

⇒ 13x2 - 325 + 75 - 315x = 0

⇒ 13x2 - 315x - 250 = 0

⇒ 13x2 - 325x + 10x - 250 = 0

⇒ 13x(x - 25) + 10(x - 25) = 0

⇒ (x - 25)(13x + 10) = 0

So, x = 25 or - (10/13)

As speed cannot be negative so x = 25

Speed of the boat = 25 km/h

So, downstream speed = 25 + 5 = 30 km/h

**∴ The speed (in km/h) of the boat when going downstream is 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Time taken to go upstream = 10/(u - v)

Time taken to go downstream = 11/(u + v)

⇒ 10/(u - v) + 11/(u + v) = 52/60

⇒ 10/(u - 5) + 11/(u + 5) = 52/60

Put the value of "u" from the option i.e.

Put u = 25 and equate the values

⇒ 10/20 + 11/30 = 52/60

⇒ (30 + 22)/60 = 52/60

⇒ 52/60 = 52/60

Hence the speed of the boat is 25 km/hr

Downstream speed = 25 + 5 = 30 km/hr
